waive.TypeOK: Shape check only: no behaviour change breaks it without also breaking a property above it, and TLC already stops with an evaluation error when an action leaves a variable unspecified.

mutations.name: drop-claim-first
mutations.why: Check no longer claims the key before the side effect (the ClaimFirst branch removed): both deliveries can charge.
mutations.search: /\ seen' = (IF ClaimFirst THEN TRUE ELSE seen)

mutations.name: dedup-preseeded
mutations.why: The dedup table already holds the key at the start, so every delivery skips and the request is lost: only the liveness property EventuallyApplied can notice.

mutations.name: remove-fairness
mutations.why: Without WF on Step the deliveries may stop before anyone applies the request.
